result.summary: The page appears largely well-formed. No critical or major visual defects were found. The layout, spacing, and typography are consistent across the header, promo banner, carousels, and list cards. Only minor consistency observations were noted.

issues.description: Restaurant cards in 'Fastest near you' show delivery fee and time but no rating, while the 'Popular right now' card shows a rating (4.8, 500+). This metadata inconsistency between sections may confuse users comparing restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Display a consistent set of metadata (rating, delivery time, fee) across all restaurant cards, or clearly differentiate the card formats by design intent.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' and 'Trattoria Piccol...' thumbnails use very dark backgrounds, while 'Green Bowl Poké' uses a light gray one, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail background treatment (e.g., consistent overlay or background tone) so cards in the same carousel feel cohesive.
